item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30384

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
Units of the Sever Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions
.
🔥
In Kharkov region
, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, two motorised infantry brigades, an unmanned systems brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a national guard brigade near Vodyanoye, Kolodeznoye, Ploskoye, Shipovatoye, Martovoye, and Velikiy Burluk (Kharkov region).
🎯
In addition, in Sumy region,
units of a mechanised brigade, an airmobile brigade, and four territorial defence brigades have been hit near Ivolzhanskoye, Velikaya Rybitsa, Belany, Korenek (Sumy region) and the city of Sumy.
▪️
The enemy lost up to 190 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line
. Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a marine brigade close to Vishnevka, Grushevakha, Smorodkovka, Glushchenkovo in Kharkov region, and Volchiy Yar in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 200 troops, two U.S.-made HMMWV armoured vehicles, 19 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation
. Strikes were delivered at formations of six mechanised brigades, a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade near Slavyansk, Kramatorsk, Druzhkovka, Vasilevskaya Pustosh, and Nikolayevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to over 210 troops, 33 motor vehicles, a U.S.-made 155-mm Paladin self-propelled artillery system, a Polish-made 155-mm Krab self-propelled artillery system, and an electronic warfare station.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 1 November 2026
item.description: 🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 1 November 2026 Part 2 ( 👉 see Part 1 ) ▫️ The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions . Manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, an air assault brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, four national guard brigades, and the Azov Special Forces Brigade have been hit near Belozerskoye, Kamyshevakha, Andreyevka, Krinitsy, Starorayskoye, Sergeyevka, Verovka, Zelenoye, and Kamenka (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 350 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, 10 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station have been neutralised. ↗️ The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence . Manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, three air assault brigades, an assault brigade, and an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit close to Podgavrilovka, Kuninova, Sidorenko, Velikomikhaylovka, Gavrilovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Novorozovka, and Zheltaya Krucha (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ The AFU lost up to 205 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, and seven motor vehicles have been neutralised. 📍 The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line. Formations of a mechanised brigade and a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Orekhov, Yulyevka, Kirovo, Kushugum, and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region). ▪️

The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions

Manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, an air assault brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, four national guard brigades, and the Azov Special Forces Brigade have been hit near Belozerskoye, Kamyshevakha, Andreyevka, Krinitsy, Starorayskoye, Sergeyevka, Verovka, Zelenoye, and Kamenka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 350 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, 10 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station have been neutralised.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence
. Manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, three air assault brigades, an assault brigade, and an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit close to Podgavrilovka, Kuninova, Sidorenko, Velikomikhaylovka, Gavrilovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Novorozovka, and Zheltaya Krucha (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU lost up to 205 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, and seven motor vehicles have been neutralised.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
Formations of a mechanised brigade and a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Orekhov, Yulyevka, Kirovo, Kushugum, and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 20 troops and eight motor vehicles were neutralised.

Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces
have inflicted damage on the energy and transport infrastructure of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, assembly workshops, storage and launch sites of unmanned aerial vehicles, ammunition depots, temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 139 areas.

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics infrastructure facilities used in support
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics infrastructure facilities used in support of the AFU as well as vessels involved in the transportation of military cargo . 💥 The strikes hit railway traffic control facilities at Konotop railway station in Sumy region, which facilitate the delivery of weapons and military equipment to the AFU from the western regions of Ukraine. 💥 Moreover, 69 km south-west of Odessa, a dry cargo ship transporting cargo intended for the AFU was struck while at sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30382

❗️
Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics infrastructure facilities used in support of the AFU as well as vessels involved in the transportation of military cargo
.
💥
The strikes hit railway traffic control facilities at Konotop railway station in Sumy region, which facilitate the delivery of weapons and military equipment to the AFU from the western regions of Ukraine.
💥
Moreover, 69 km south-west of Odessa, a dry cargo ship transporting cargo intended for the AFU was struck while at sea.
🔹
